scope: T10A04: APIMatic generates the Python and TypeScript Merchant SDKs and the developer portal from sdk/merchant-openapi.json, then a smoke script exercises the generated client.

sdk_generation.generator: @apimatic/cli 1.5.0 (official package), authenticated with the owner's APIMatic account; the account reported all seven languages allowed
sdk_generation.input: sdk/merchant-openapi.json (OpenAPI 3.1, exactly ten operations) plus APIMatic's official APIMATIC-META.json
sdk_generation.document_fix: APIMatic read the bid body's boolean const as the string "True"; tools/export_merchant_openapi.py now states confirmed as type boolean and sdk/merchant-openapi.json was regenerated. backend/tests/unit/test_merchant_openapi_contract.py pins it. The server still accepts only true.
sdk_generation.licensing: the generator writes an MIT LICENSE into each SDK; the repository is MIT

smoke.result: the generated client exposes the ten operations; a MerchantApiBidRequest serializes confirmed as a JSON boolean; the contracted structured body round-trips. ALL SMOKE CHECKS PASSED.
smoke.live_bid: skipped in this run; the script supports one real bid through the generated client when FAIRPOOL_SMOKE_BASE_URL, FAIRPOOL_SMOKE_API_KEY and FAIRPOOL_SMOKE_LOT_ID are set

attempts: apimatic portal generate with the FairPool document and a minimal APIMATIC-BUILD.json -> server error: An unexpected error occurred
apimatic portal generate with APIMatic's own unchanged sample input (build file, spec, metadata, content, images) -> the same server error
portal.isolation: the official sample fails identically, so the cause is the APIMatic account/service entitlement, not this repository's document or configuration
portal.claim_rule: no portal is committed and no portal claim appears in the README, the Devpost text or the video

blocked_on: APIMatic portal generation (account entitlement or service error). The SDKs, smoke and provenance are complete.
gate_rule: Stays blocked until a portal is generated. The owner may explicitly waive the portal item with a dated decision, as OD-P3-2 did at IG-3; the file then records the waiver and the gap, never a fabricated portal.
